title: Hunt or be Hunted
description: Turns Minecraft into an Asymmetrical Horror Game
body:
**_This mod is Intended to be played in Multiplayer_**


**_This mod is in an early alpha, so please be aware of bugs and balancing issues that may exist._**
**_If you encounter a Bug you can report it too our Discord in the #bug_reports channel_**

# Welcome to the Realm
It would apear you were one of the misfortunate people to end up being cloned into the Realm by whatever is above now being forced to either Run away and Survive or Hunt down and Kill, No worries however as there are tools to assist you on your goal! either it be a weapon, or a Medkit. But your goal is clear, just how will you go about completing your goal?

## Hunt
As The Killer your only goal is too Kill all the Survivors, there are many ways to do that already in minecraft itself but depending on what Killer is chosen you will have Abilitys you can use to make you job Easier esspecally while Chasing a Survivor

The Current Roster of Killers are
- The King _Owned by **Alan Becker**_
- The Betrayed
- B-17 _Owned by **Toby**_
- The Puppet _Owned by **Scott Cawthon**_
- The Hollow Knight _Owned by **Team Cherry**_

Killers that are planned for the future are
- Agony
- Eden _Owned by **SeraphiXs**_

[**_Information on all Killers and their abilities (Google Doc)_**](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-24d_GOgFlPCwsMcb_76Y6vHMHUGmdogprCPz6H9vrY/edit?usp=sharing)

## Survive
As a Survivor your only goal is to Survive, Unlike the Killers you dont play as a Character such as B-17, The King, etc you play as a regular Minecraft player there are Custom Items to assist you however there are no special abilitys

The Current Items for Survivors are
- Medkit
- Adrenaline
- Talisman
